**How to read the charts**

- **Five-day return** is the average close-to-close return of the tickers in each group. Blue bars are gains and orange bars are losses.
- **Volatility** is the average annualized volatility of the tickers in each group, measured from daily returns over the last 20 trading days.
- Read them together: a group with a large loss and high volatility is under stress; a small move with low volatility is calm.
- Macro series are left out because a yield or an index level is not comparable with a tradable price.

## Reading the table

- **1d %** and **5d %** are close-to-close returns over one and five trading days.
- **vs 20d / 50d / 200d avg %** show how far the latest close sits above (positive) or below (negative) its 20-, 50- and 200-day moving average: the short-, medium- and long-term trend.
- **trend** is a rule-based label: **Up** when the close is above the 50-day average and the 50-day is above the 200-day; **Down** when both are reversed; **Mixed** otherwise. It describes the current trend. It is not a forecast and not a recommendation to buy or sell.
- Prices are daily closes from Yahoo Finance, adjusted for splits and dividends.

## Symbol guide

**Macro series**

| Symbol | What it is | How to read it |
|---|---|---|
| ^TNX | 10-year US Treasury yield, in percent | Rises when bond prices fall; the benchmark long-term interest rate |
| ^VIX | Cboe Volatility Index | Expected S&P 500 volatility over the next 30 days; rises when investors are fearful |
| DX-Y.NYB | US Dollar Index | The dollar against a basket of major currencies; rises when the dollar strengthens |
| CL=F | Crude oil futures (WTI), dollars per barrel | The US oil price benchmark |
| GC=F | Gold futures, dollars per ounce | The gold price |
| HG=F | Copper futures, dollars per pound | A gauge of global industrial demand |

**How the symbols are built**

- A symbol starting with `^` is an index.
- A symbol ending in `=F` is a futures contract. The `=F` is a suffix added by Yahoo Finance, the data source, to mark futures; it is not part of the exchange's own code.
- The letters before `=F` are the exchange's trading code for the product:

| Symbol | Exchange code | Stands for |
|---|---|---|
| CL=F | CL | Crude Light: light sweet crude oil (WTI), traded on the New York Mercantile Exchange |
| GC=F | GC | Gold, traded on the COMEX exchange |
| HG=F | HG | High Grade copper, traded on the COMEX exchange |

Futures contracts expire monthly. Each `=F` symbol shows the nearest contract
and rolls to the next one automatically, so the price series can shift
slightly on a roll date.

**Funds**

| Symbol | What it holds |
|---|---|
| SPY, QQQ, IWM | S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, and Russell 2000 small caps |
| TLT | Long-term US Treasury bonds (20+ years) |
| TIP | Inflation-protected Treasury bonds |
| LQD, HYG | Investment-grade and high-yield corporate bonds |
| KRE | US regional banks |
| XLU | US utilities |
| XLV | US healthcare companies |
| SMH | Semiconductor companies |
| GLD, SLV | Physical gold and silver |
| EEM, FXI, EWJ | Emerging markets, large Chinese companies, and Japan |

All other symbols are individual company stocks.

```{=html}
<script>
// Show trend labels as small bordered tags with a direction mark.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var marks = { Up: "\u25B2 Up", Down: "\u25BC Down", Mixed: "\u2013 Mixed" };
  document.querySelectorAll("main table").forEach(function (table) {
    var heads = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll("thead th")).map(function (th) {
      return th.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    });
    var col = heads.indexOf("trend");
    if (col < 0) return;
    table.classList.add("dashboard-table", "column-body-outset");
    table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr").forEach(function (row) {
      var cell = row.children[col];
      if (!cell) return;
      var value = cell.textContent.trim();
      if (!marks[value]) return;
      cell.innerHTML = '<span class="trend-pill ' + value.toLowerCase() + '">' + marks[value] + "</span>";
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
